latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of the ufo skill — a comprehensive workbench for multi-source UAP/UFO document triage, evidence grading, and structured analysis.

- Provides automated analysis of declassified UAP/UFO/FOIA releases from multiple agencies and archives (war.gov, AARO, FBI Vault, NARA, Congress, and more)
- Implements source triage, detailed evidence-provenance scoring, claim taxonomy, redaction analytics, and cross-release comparison
- Upgrades the previous uap-release-analyzer with skepticism guardrails, entity mapping, uncertainty tracking, and graded analytic artifacts
- Designed for investigating, comparing, or building structured reports on UAP/UFO document sets from varied sources
